audio.who: Александар Сариевски, Мандолински оркестар на Рамадан Шукри
Анастасиа Митровска, Оркестар на Златко Миладиноски

lines.en: The hero Gjuro fell sick,

lines.cyr: разболел ми се, в Бистра планина,
lines.lat: razbolel mi se, v Bistra planina,
lines.en: he fell sick, in the Bistra mountain,
at the sheep pen Solumunica.

lines.cyr: Ој, ти бре брате, брате Стојане,
lines.lat: Oj, ti bre brate, brate Stojane,
lines.en: Hey you, brother Stojan,
mount your horse, dark red horse,
and go down to the field of Solun.
Field of Solun, sheep district,
sheep district, village of Panonija

lines.cyr: и да ја викнеш, сестра Марија.
lines.lat: i da ja vikneš, sestra Marija.
lines.en: and call my sister Marija.
Stojan obeyed his brother Gjuro
and went down to the field of Solun

lines.cyr: за да ја викне сестра Марија.
lines.lat: za da ja vikne sestra Marija.
lines.en: to call his sister Marija.

lines.cyr: Готви се, сестро, на свадба да одиш,
lines.lat: Gotvi se, sestro, na svadba da odiš,
lines.en: Prepare, my sister, to go to a wedding,

lines.cyr: ќа ми се женит братот ми Ѓуро,
lines.lat: ḱa mi se ženit bratot mi Ǵuro,
lines.en: our brother Gjuro will get married,

lines.cyr: ќа ми се женит братот ми Ѓуро.
lines.lat: ḱa mi se ženit bratot mi Ǵuro.
lines.en: our brother Gjuro will get married.

lines.cyr: Еј, ти бре, брате, брате Стојане,
lines.lat: Ej, ti bre, brate, brate Stojane,
lines.en: Hey you brother, brother Stojan,
should I wear clothes of joy,
or should I wear clothes of sorrow?
When they came to Kalenberica,
sister Marija asked Stojan:
- Why are the birds singing sad songs?
Here we have all sorts of birds,
and that's why you hear some sad songs,
and that's why you hear some sad songs.
When they came to Bistra mountain:
- Why does it smell like incense,

lines.cyr: да не е умрел братот ми Ѓуро?
lines.lat: da ne e umrel bratot mi Ǵuro?
lines.en: is my brother Gjuro dead?
Here we have all sorts of flowers,
and that's why you think you smell incense,
and that's why you think you smell incense.
When they came to river Bistrica,
at the sheep pen Solumnica:
- Why are there gathered so much shepherds?

lines.cyr: Да не го носет братот ми Ѓуро?
lines.lat: Da ne go noset bratot mi Ǵuro?
lines.en: Are they carrying my brother Gjuro?

lines.cyr: Не ми го носет левенди Ѓуро,
lines.lat: Ne mi go noset levendi Ǵuro,
lines.en: - They are not carrying the hero Gjuro,

lines.cyr: туку го женет за црна земја!
lines.lat: tuku go ženet za crna zemja!
lines.en: they are marrying him to the black earth!
